station: Bournemouth pier tide gauge (Environment Agency E71939)
method: Harmonic prediction (UTide, 67 constituents incl. shallow-water) fitted by 365 Techies to 367 days of Environment Agency 15-minute readings, 2025-09-15 to 2026-09-16.
licence: Contains Environment Agency data licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0

datum.cd_source: BODC Bournemouth site history: Admiralty Chart Datum = ODN - 1.40 m

accuracy.method: fitted without the last 30 days of readings, then compared with what the gauge measured in those 30 days
